findings.summary: Five separate false claims across the tutorial plugin's own JSDoc headers, including two that point apps at a `tutor` facade object that does not exist anywhere in the tree.
findings.change: Corrected all five: triggers.ts's 'nine generic kinds' (there are TEN, and `action` is built-in, not app-registered — app-gmt registers only `tab` + `mode`); types.ts's `tutor.registerTrigger(...)` -> the real `tutorTriggers.register(...)`; tutorial/lessons.ts's `tutor.registerLessons` -> the free `registerLesson` / `registerLessons`; Overlay.tsx's `positionTarget` placement field, collapsed long ago into the `position: PositionConfig` object; Tutorial.tsx crediting setTutorialStorageKey with appending the `-tutorials` suffix, when uiSlice assigns the key verbatim and installTutorial appends at the call site.
findings.verification: Each claim re-derived by grep against the tree. `registerBuiltinTriggers()` registers ten kinds (value, bool, delta, compound, or, keypress, keypress_all, delay, action, manual). `grep -rn registerTrigger` hits nothing but the comment being removed — no such symbol and no `tutor` object. `grep -rn positionTarget` finds only the port note and the stale header. typecheck green (comments only, no emit change).

findings.summary: The runner's header claimed 'on step exit / unmount it cleans up timers + listeners and runs step.onExit'. Only the first half is true, and only on one of four paths — on unmount neither onExit nor the cleanup runs, leaking the active trigger's keydown listeners and timers.
findings.change: Header corrected to state the real teardown matrix per path. Documented rather than changed: altering when teardown fires is a behaviour decision, not a doc repair.
findings.verification: Traced all four effects. step->step is the only onExit call site (`grep -n onExit runner.ts` = two hits, both in that block). Lesson end: the entry effect bails at `if (!step) return`, the end-of-lesson effect calls completeTutorial(), the deactivation effect fires cleanupRef only — no onExit. skipTutorial takes the same deactivation path. Unmount: the entry effect's returned cleanup is a deliberate no-op and the deactivation effect returns nothing, so neither runs. Both are LATENT, not live: `grep -n onExit app-gmt/tutorial/lessons.ts` is empty, and AppGmt.tsx mounts <TutorialRunner /> unconditionally at the app root so it never unmounts.

findings.summary: All eight @invariant annotations in this subsystem name no command that would go red if they were false, so per CLAUDE.md they are assumptions, not invariants.
findings.change: All eight downgraded to @assumption, text byte-identical — only the marker changes. Sites: lessons.ts (seedMandelbulb needs a populated registry; lesson-2 chain detection), anchors.ts (get() returns first non-zero-rect entry), runner.ts (advancingRef cleared in a queueMicrotask; the step-entry effect's cleanup is an empty body; autoStartLesson chains completeTutorial + a 300ms setTimeout), triggers.ts (valuesEqual recurses with a key-count guard; delta snapshots go through JSON round-trip).
findings.verification: All eight checked against the code first and all eight are currently TRUE — this is a downgrade of evidence, not a correction of content. Unprovability established two ways: no harness drives the tutorial (`grep -rln tutorial debug/*.mts` matches only frag-importer corpus paths), and the one cited guard that reaches these files, smoke:undo, was falsified directly by inverting the `bool` trigger comparator and stayed green 20/20. Reverted; typecheck green.
